asr_text: But is this feeling limited to English? Wanting a mark of achievement more than the content? Wanting a reward more than reaching your goal? If you felt that way, you may recognize a little of yourself in the urge to chase rare words. Oh, please don't look at me. Of course, this system alone can't tell us whether people really get more interested in opening packs than in memorizing words. Still, if it's rare, makes you stop and look at a word you would have passed by because it seemed useful, that's an interesting way to spark curiosity. It's unexpected to find a gotcha at the entrance, though. What did you learn today? More importantly, ask me what I drew. If that's what you feel like saying, maybe you have what it takes to be a rare word hunter. Now, before we move on to the next card, shall we look at the word's meaning too?
